learn.latest: A measurement item a decision depends on goes to a PR the day it passes safety, split from anything waiting on approval; any change to a screen gets its "seen" marker in the same build or first.
A script that runs before hydration only changes attributes or fills the innerHTML of an empty element React rendered; read the production console on every variant before pushing.
For every EVENT_NAMES entry, write one line pairing it with the clause words that cover it, read from the place in the code that fires it. On a re-review, check each condition I set earlier.
When drafts have waited two weeks, the plan picks ONE route and the smallest send (one message to up to 5 known players), not three.
An open crash count that does not move for a week is old rows nobody marked fixed, not a new fault; say "unchanged", do not re-rank it.
Motion is transform and opacity only, eased, 60 fps, tested on a throttled CPU; plain boxes and bare bars are not finished.
